Definition: to be (causatively make) large (in various senses, as in body, mind, estate or honor, also in pride)
BiblicalUsage: 1) to grow, become great or important, promote, make powerful, praise, magnify, do great things; 1a) (Qal); 1a1) to grow up; 1a2) to become great; 1a3) to be magnified; 1b) (Piel); 1b1) to cause to grow; 1b2) to make great, powerful; 1b3) to magnify; 1c) (Pual) to be brought up; 1d) (Hiphil); 1d1) to make great; 1d2) to magnify; 1d3) to do great things; 1e) (Hithpael) to magnify oneself
